children: Seth David Wexler, an officer serving as EVP, General Counsel & Secretary, sold 120,000 shares of common stock at a weighted average price of $12.75 per share for a total reported sale amount of $1,530,000, and after the transaction he directly owns 404,582 shares of common stock.

William Andrew Hendricks Jr, a director serving as President & CEO, sold 250,000 shares in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $12.90 to $12.96 with a weighted average price of $12.93 per share for a total reported sale amount of $3,232,500, and after the sale he directly owns 2,292,474 shares of common stock.

Drummond Robert Wayne Jr, a director, sold common stock in two transactions on 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-02 at a weighted average price of $12.85 per share (range $12.85–$12.86) for a total reported sale amount of $2,570,000, and after the transactions he directly owns 928,773 shares.
